name: Kaleido
summary: Kawasaki's 'robust humanoid platform', developed with the University of Tokyo since 2015 and first shown at iREX 2017: a tethered 175 cm, 85 kg biped that could get up from the floor and do pull-ups. It walked untethered on its own battery by 2019, and the ninth generation, Kaleido 9, appeared at iREX 2025. Kawasaki plans a rollout around 2030 with its Noetra AI, adding autonomy in stages.
notable: Built to take falls and hard contact rather than avoid them
